name: Deferred Voxel Shading
definition: A four-step real-time global illumination technique that computes indirect lighting (diffuse, specular, color-blending, emissive, shadows, ambient occlusion) by voxelizing scene data, computing direct lighting per voxel, and using voxel cone tracing for indirect illumination.
summary: Deferred Voxel Shading is a real-time global illumination technique that merges voxel cone tracing with deferred shading to compute indirect lighting effects as a screenspace post-process.
